$comment: Single source of truth for every image on the site. Read by src/data/images.ts (which turns keys into optimized imports), by scripts/generate-placeholders.mjs (which draws a labelled plate for anything still missing), and by scripts/images-readme.mjs (which regenerates src/assets/images/README.md). Add an image here first, then everywhere else follows. 'status' is either 'real' (a genuine asset is in place) or 'placeholder' (awaiting a real file from the client).

images.purpose: The PrimeTrack Telematics logo. Transparent background, square. Sourced from the live site.

images.usedOn: NOT CURRENTLY USED. The homepage hero is now the scroll-driven route graphic in HeroJourney.astro, which needs no photograph. The slot is kept in case a photographic hero is ever wanted again; nothing is missing from the site while it is empty.
images.purpose: A commercial vehicle or small fleet on a Rwandan road. Kigali arterial, a provincial highway, or a depot yard. Wide framing with room on the left for the headline. Shot in daylight, no heavy filters. Should read as a working vehicle, not a showroom shot.

images.usedOn: Homepage, AI video telematics feature section
images.purpose: Road-facing dash camera mounted on a windscreen, its screen showing the live forward view. Supplied by PrimeTrack, August 2026.

PrimeTrack fuel tank monitoring board: a branded tanker, the tank sensor, and the platform view with refuelling and fuel-drain events called out. Marketing artwork with printed type, so it must never be cropped to a house ratio.
Two real screenshots of the PrimeTrack mobile app side by side: the live vehicle map and the reports list. A genuine app capture, not a mock-up. NOTE: the status bar reads MTN NG, a Nigerian carrier.

images.usedOn: Video Trackers product page and product cards
images.purpose: PrimeTrack video telematics dash camera and DVR unit, front and rear faces, with the recorded forward view on the screen. Higher-resolution replacement for the low-res version carried over from the live site.

images.usedOn: Solar Trackers product page and product cards
images.purpose: A tractor unit at dusk with location pins above it. Illustrative rather than a photograph of the PrimeSOLAR device itself, so a shot of the real unit would still be an improvement.

images.usedOn: Fuel Trackers product page and product cards
images.purpose: PrimeTrack fuel monitoring board: the capacitive tank probe and its harness beside the platform fuel view. Marketing artwork with printed type; do not crop.

images.usedOn: STAR Trackers product page and product cards
images.purpose: A stand-alone rechargeable tracker unit, showing the case and its ports. A shot of one magnetised to a container would still add scale.

images.usedOn: Fleet Trackers product page and product cards
images.purpose: PrimeTrack fleet board: a convoy at dusk under the line Smarter Fleet, Stronger Business, with the four capability callouts. Marketing artwork with printed type; do not crop.

images.usedOn: eCT Systems product page and product cards
images.purpose: PrimeTrack-branded electronic cargo smart padlock with its unlocking methods called out. Genuine branded product imagery carried over from the live site. A higher-resolution version would still be welcome.

A real screenshot of the PrimeTrack GPS tracking and telematics platform: live map, vehicle detail panel and speed and fuel gauges. NOTE: the vehicle shown is in Lagos and its IMEI, SIM number and plate are legible.
Over-the-shoulder view of a professional driver at the wheel of a truck on an open road.
PrimeTrack API board: an open hand under an API panel ringed with integration icons, under the line Connect. Integrate. Empower. Marketing artwork with printed type; do not crop.
The PrimeTrack Rwanda office at Yyussa City Centre, Kigali, or the team at work there. Helps a visitor confirm the company is physically present.
A PrimeTrack technician fitting or servicing a device on a customer vehicle. This is the single strongest credibility image on the site: it shows real people doing the actual work.

images.usedOn: Open Graph and Twitter card fallback, every page
images.purpose: The social share card, shown whenever a primetrack.rw link is pasted into WhatsApp, LinkedIn, Slack, X or iMessage. The PrimeTrack logo centred on white, generated from the logo by scripts/generate-og.mjs. White rather than the brand ink because the wordmark and inner arc are black and would vanish on a dark ground; a dark card would need a knockout version of the logo, which does not exist in this repo. Re-run the script after any logo change.
